description: Delete masks (or all of them: Layer > Masks > Remove All Masks), duplicate them (Edit > Duplicate), select them or move the selection to the next or previous mask, toggle Layer > Mask > Hide Locked Masks, or limit an effect to masks (the effect's Compositing Options > Mask Reference)

action.description: delete (every mask when masks is omitted), duplicate, select (only these), select_next or select_previous (from the selected mask on each layer), toggle_hide_locked (Hide Locked Masks on the layers), reference_in_effect (add the masks to an effect's Mask Reference list)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

effect.description: reference_in_effect: the effect on the layer, by name or 1-based index in the Effect Controls panel

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

masks.description: Which masks on each layer: indexes (1-based, as in the Timeline) or names. Omit for every mask

name: manage_masks
title: Manage Masks
